title: Standing Firm on Principle
paragraphs: Karim's manager asks him to make the sales numbers look a little better. The manager wants to impress upper management. Karim feels uncomfortable, even though the change looks small.
Karim speaks politely. He says that he cannot show numbers that are not correct. He offers to show the real numbers with a clear plan for improvement.
At first, his manager is a little annoyed. Later, he respects Karim's answer. The honest report shows real progress that the false report would hide.
Karim learns that small choices matter. Standing firm in a small situation can help build good character over time.
